ms.report:
Targeted deliverables achieved within the expected time. The below items were implemented.
1 - Disabled auto staking-reward withdrawal before the Plomin HF
-> https://github.com/LedgerHQ/ledger-live/pull/8770
-> https://github.com/LedgerHQ/ledger-live/pull/8812
2 - Enable Auto Reward Withdrawal along with Auto Abstain Drep Delegation
-> https://github.com/LedgerHQ/ledger-live/pull/9276
-> https://github.com/LedgerHQ/ledger-live/pull/9412
3 - Upgraded relevant packages and new certificates (Part of PR above, see the commit below)
-> https://github.com/LedgerHQ/ledger-live/pull/9276/commits/d0550019b2e608197b6d4e4f61cf3527dc38eeae
4 - Written Test cases extensive test cases
-> https://github.com/LedgerHQ/ledger-live/pull/9276/commits/759845e4ab177d724340a8c0e957dbf662b9d41d

Summary
Disabled auto-staking reward withdrawal before Plomin HF for a smooth transition and to avoid locked wallets. After Plomin HF added Auto Abstain Drep delegation for all Ledger Live users in order to enable staking reward withdrawal. Enabled auto staking reward withdrawal as a native feature of Ledger Live. Written test cases for the newly added upgrades.

Reported Issues
No reported issues during this period.

Knowledge Sharing with Ledger team
We held multiple discussions with Ledger team on their Discord and a few video meetings. We covered wide range of upgrade requirements and Plomin HF related features. Shared information on Drep, staking reward related changes, and actions that must be taken to enable Ledger Live to be a functional Cardano wallet after the HF. We also discussed the new Cardano governance and its features.

Summary
Staking registration and de-registration certificates are deprecated, and new certificate formats are introduced in the conway era. Both old and new certificate formats are compatible as of now but it was required to upgrade to the new certificates for better compatibility and the support for the old certificates (transaction format) would not be compatible with next hf. In this milestone we have upgrades the deprecated certificates to the new conway era ceritificate specification.
We have also updated the supported token list in Ledger Live.

Reported Issues
1 User can not see part of their wallet balance after staking
 -> This was an issue on the user side and not a bug within Ledger Live. User had lost the ledger nano device and was trying to import the wallet using cli tools. We helped user recover their wallet succesfully without using a ledger device.
2. User reported an issue while trying to generate receive address.
 -> We helped debug the error and it was an issue from the nano app side and not Ledger Live. This was the only one such report and it was never reported again.

Knowledge Sharing with Ledger team
We had extensive discussions with the new Ledger Live team lead on Cardano address specifications. ms.report:
Code Delivery
Below are the items we deliveried as part of this milestone,
1 - Updated spendable balance to include available staking rewards, if the wallet is delegated to a dRep
2 - No new tokens added in nano app to sync with Ledger Live, hence this task was not needed.
GitHub PR - https://github.com/LedgerHQ/ledger-live/pull/12362
Summary
In this milestone we have updated the users wallet balance UI to also include staking rewards. Rewards are auto withdrawan when doing a transaction so the spendable balance kept updating, but there are instances where user does not do any transaction and staking rewards keep accumulating. So in order to show the upto date spendable balance we have added staking rewards as part of spendable balance as it is spendable when user does a transaction. 
Reported Issues

1. Some users were unable to unstake wallet
 -> There was a bug where user's staking deposit was syncing as 0 instead of 2 ADA, and hence the un-stake functionality was not working, it was fixed within 24 hours of the report.
2. Users unable to submit transactions
 -> when there were high load of failing tx, our transaction submission service was not able to cope and wad restarting, we fixed this issue within 24 hours of the report.
Knowledge Sharing with Ledger team
Apart from this milestone, we are in the process of discussing Cardano dRep delegation updates within Ledger Live.
